entries.name: zone.aspect
entries.description: Get the measure of a zone’s aspect ratio. Values near zero indicate a zone with a large aspect ratio. This is defined as the ratio of the smallest to the largest edge length among edges of a zone.

entries.name: zone.block.gp
entries.description: Get the FLAC3D gridpoint for the input zone-block coupling item and gridpoint number (from 1 to 4). Each coupling item consists of a single 3DEC vertex and 3 or 4 FLAC3D gridpoints (defining the intersected face).

entries.name: zone.block.list
entries.description: Get the list of zone block coupling items. Each item in the list is a single 3DEC vertex and an array or 3 or 4 FLAC3D gridpoints with weights.

entries.name: zone.block.numgp
entries.description: Get the number of FLAC3D gridpoints for the input zone-block coupling item. This can be 3 or 4 depending on the number of gridpoints of the FLAC3D zone face that is coupled to the 3DEC vertex.

entries.name: zone.block.typeid
entries.description: Get the zone-block coupling data structure type number. The typeid can be used to uniquely identify zone-block FISH pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: zone.block.vertex
entries.description: Get the 3DEC vertex for the input zone-block coupling item.

entries.name: zone.block.weight
entries.description: Get the weight associated with the FLAC3D gridpoint for the input zone-block coupling item and gridpoint number (from 1 to 4).

entries.name: zone.code
entries.description: Get the zone code. This is an integer that indicates available zone types.

entries.name: zone.condition
entries.description: Get the zone condition number. This is a general value indicating how geometrically well formed the zone is. A value of 1.0 indicates a perfect tet zone (all edges are equal in length). A value of 0.0 indicates an unusable zone.

entries.name: zone.containing
entries.description: Get the zone that encompasses the point v. The optional value start can be given to seed the search with the last zone found at that point. This zone is checked first and will be the only zone checked if valid, speeding up the check.

entries.name: zone.copy
entries.description: Copies the zone state information from the source zone to the destination zone. The return value is always 0.

entries.name: zone.create.gp
entries.description: Create a zone given a list of grid points.

entries.name: zone.create.interface.elem
entries.description: Create new interface elements attached to a zone face.

entries.name: zone.create.pos
entries.description: Create a zone given a list of locations in space.

entries.name: zone.create.ratio
entries.description: Get a value calculated by a geometric progression, given a ratio , an index, and a size.

entries.name: zone.creep.time.total
entries.description: Get/set the total accumulated zone module creep time. This accumulates the timesteps of every cycle the zone creep module is active.

entries.name: zone.creep.timestep
entries.description: Get/set the timestep used by the zone creep module when it is active. This may not be the timestep used, as other active modules may require a smaller timestep.

entries.name: zone.cycle.init
entries.description: Initialize the zone for cycling. This must be used when zones are created while cycling.

entries.name: zone.density
entries.description: Get/set the density of the zone.

entries.name: zone.dynamic.mul
entries.description: Get the multiplier calculated for a zone when dynamic multistepping is active. See Dynamic Multi-stepping for further discussion.

entries.name: zone.dynamic.time.total
entries.description: Get the total accumulated zone module dynamic time. This accumulates the timesteps of every cycle the zone dynamic module is active.

entries.name: zone.dynamic.timestep
entries.description: Get/set the timestep used by the zone dynamic module when it is active. This may not be the timestep used, as other active modules may require a smaller timestep.

entries.name: zone.extra
entries.description: Get/sets the value stored in the ith extra variable array of zone z.

entries.name: zone.face.area
entries.description: Get the area of the face.

entries.name: zone.face.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value of the index in the extra variable array associated with the zone face z and iside.

entries.name: zone.face.find
entries.description: In FLAC2D, get the face index of zone z that contains the two gridpoints gp1, gp2.

entries.name: zone.face.find.normal
entries.description: Get the face index of zone z whose outward-facing normal is closest to the direction of v.

entries.name: zone.face.gp
entries.description: Get a pointer to a gridpoint on face given by zone z, iside, and ivertex, as described in Orientation of Nodes and Faces within a Zone.

entries.name: zone.face.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to face iside of zone z in slot slot, if provided. On get, the slot named 'Default' is used if slot is not provided. On set, if slot is omitted, all group/slot assignments are returned.

entries.name: zone.face.group.remove
entries.description: Removes the group name s from the face identified by z and iside in any slot where it is found. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided. The return value is 0 if the specified group is not assigned to that face.

entries.name: zone.face.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group name s is associated with the zone face indicated by z and iside and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: zone.face.normal
entries.description: Get the normal to the face, facing outward from zone z.

entries.name: zone.face.normal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the normal to the face, facing outward from zone z.

entries.name: zone.face.pos
entries.description: Get the position of the face, defined as the centroid of its grid points.

entries.name: zone.face.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position of the face, defined as the centroid of its grid points.

entries.name: zone.face.size
entries.description: Get the number of unique face vertices. A quadrilateral face will return 4; a triangular face will return 3. A number less than three indicates that this is a degenerate face that is not valid.

entries.name: zone.field.component
entries.description: Get/set the scalar value retrieved from a name that returns a vector. If the type is not a vector, this value is ignored. Valid strings are x, y, z (3D ONLY), and magnitude.

entries.name: zone.field.extra
entries.description: Get/set the index used to retrieve extra variables. By default, this is 1.

entries.name: zone.field.get
entries.description: Get data from the model at the location specified by v. The optional argument fdef specifies which value to return if v is not inside any zone in the model. By default, fdef = 0.0.

entries.name: zone.field.get.gp
entries.description: Get data directly from the gridpoint gp and zone z. Note that one of the two values may not be required, depending on the type of data queried and the extrapolation method specified.

entries.name: zone.field.gravity
entries.description: Get/set gravitational force setting. If true, then gravitational forces are included in applied forces. If false, (the default) they are not.

entries.name: zone.field.hide.fluidnull
entries.description: Get/set the null fluid constitutive model setting. If true, then zones with a null fluid constitutive model are ignored in computing gridpoint values from zone data. The default setting is false.

entries.name: zone.field.hide.mechnull
entries.description: Get/set the null mechanical constitutive model setting. If true, then zones with a null mechanical constitutive model are ignored in computing gridpoint values from zone data. The default setting is true.

entries.name: zone.field.hide.null
entries.description: Get/set the null setting. If true, then null zones are ignored in computing gridpoint values from zone data. The default setting is true.

entries.name: zone.field.hide.thermnull
entries.description: Get/set the null thermal constitutive model setting. If true, then zones with a null thermal constitutive model are ignored in computing gridpoint values from zone data. The default setting is false.

entries.name: zone.field.index
entries.description: Get/set the the index number of the data type name that should be queried.

entries.name: zone.field.init
entries.description: Initializes the zone field data system for the current method and the current data type. Results of calculations are stored internally where possible to minimize the calculations caused by multiple calls to zone.field.get.

entries.name: zone.field.log
entries.description: Get/set the logarithmic setting. If true, then the base-ten log of the absolute value of all scalar values are returned. The default is false.

entries.name: zone.field.method.index
entries.description: Get/set the index number of the extrapolation method used for zone-based variables.

entries.name: zone.field.method.name
entries.description: Get/set the method used for extrapolation of zone-based variables.

entries.name: zone.field.name
entries.description: Get/set the name of the value being retrieved from zones. A list of all available names can be seen in the Zone Field Data Names table.

entries.name: zone.field.power
entries.description: Get/set the power exponent used for the inverse-distance-weighting method of extrapolation. The default is 3.0.

entries.name: zone.field.prop
entries.description: Get/set the name of the property to retrieve when the zone.field.name has been set to property, property-fluid, or property-thermal.

entries.name: zone.field.quantity
entries.description: Get/set the scalar quantity to retrieve when the value being obtained is a tensor. This value is ignored if the type is not a tensor. The available quantity names are listed in the following table.

entries.name: zone.field.radius.ratio
entries.description: Get/set the the radius ratio parameter used for the inverse-distance-weighting method of extrapolation. The default is 0.75.

entries.name: zone.field.reset
entries.description: Removes the effect of zone.field.init. The return value is ignored.

entries.name: zone.field.source
entries.description: Get/set where values are derived from when appropriate.

entries.name: zone.field.tol
entries.description: Get/set the tolerance used for the polynomial method of extrapolation. The default is 1e-7.

entries.name: zone.field.type
entries.description: Get/set the type to assume, for those values where the type can change. This includes extra and property. The valid types are scalar, vector, or tensor. The default is scalar.

entries.name: zone.field.velocity.limit
entries.description: Get/set the limiting velocity used to determine stability in the data created after a factor of safety calculation.

entries.name: zone.find
entries.description: Get the zone with internally assigned ID number i.

entries.name: zone.flow
entries.description: Get the specific discharge vector for the zone. The unit is L/T

entries.name: zone.flow.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the specific discharge vector for the zone.

entries.name: zone.fluid.density
entries.description: Get/set the fluid density for the zone.

entries.name: zone.fluid.model
entries.description: Get/set the fluid flow constitituve model for the zone. The constitutive models currently available are active and inactive.

entries.name: zone.fluid.prop
entries.description: Get/set the value for fluid property s in zone z.

entries.name: zone.fluid.prop.index
entries.description: Returns the index of the property with name s in the fluid constitutive model

entries.name: zone.fluid.ratio
entries.description: Get the current fluid convergence ratio for zones. This is defined as the ratio of total unbalanced flow to the total flow through the zones.

entries.name: zone.fluid.stress.normal
entries.description: Get the representative stress magnitude for the fast flow solution scheme.

entries.name: zone.fluid.time.total
entries.description: Get/set the total accumulated zone module fluid time. This accumulates the timesteps of every cycle the zone fluid module is active.

entries.name: zone.fluid.unbal.avg
entries.description: Get the average unbalanced fluid volume limit for the fast flow solution scheme.

entries.name: zone.fluid.unbal.max
entries.description: Get the maximum unbalanced fluid limit for the fast flow solution scheme.

entries.name: zone.flux
entries.description: Get the zone average heat flux vector.

entries.name: zone.flux.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the zone average heat flux vector.

entries.name: zone.force.update
entries.description: Flags the cycling logic so that a geometry update is performed at the start of the next cycle.

entries.name: zone.geom.test
entries.description: Test the geometric fitness of a zone. Returns true if the zone is good and false if the zone is bad.

entries.name: zone.gp
entries.description: Get a list of the the grid points associated with the zone.

entries.name: zone.gp.num
entries.description: Get the number of unique gridpoints associated with this type of zone.

entries.name: zone.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to zone z in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: zone.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the zone in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: zone.head
entries.description: Get the first zone in the list of all zones in the model.

entries.name: zone.hysteretic
entries.description: Get/set the hysteretic damping parameter s in zone z. s can have the following possible values: c0, c1, c2, c3, modfac, reduction-minimum, model, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, and e6.

entries.name: zone.id
entries.description: Get the zone ID number, a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: zone.inbox
entries.description: Get a list of zones with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the zone. Specifying b = false indicates that only zones with positions falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: zone.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the zone and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: zone.islive
entries.description: Checks if the zone is “live”, meaning it has a non-null mechanical, thermal, or fluid constitutive model.

entries.name: zone.join
entries.description: Get the zone joined to face i of zone z. This will return null if there is no zone connected to that face. Note that the connection must be topologically perfect.

entries.name: zone.link.index
entries.description: Get the index of the next zone in the list of all zones connected to a gridpoint.

entries.name: zone.link.zone
entries.description: Get the next zone in the list of all zones connected to the gridpoint attached to zone z at index index.

entries.name: zone.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all zones in the model.

entries.name: zone.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any zone in this model. The next zone created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: zone.mech.convergence
entries.description: Get the current maximum value of convergence in any gridpoint in the model. See the model solve convergence keyword.

entries.name: zone.mech.prop.name
entries.description: Get the name of the ith property in the list of properties associated with the mechanical constitutive model for that zone. If there are less than i properties available, an error occurs. See zone.mech.prop.num.

entries.name: zone.mech.prop.num
entries.description: Get the total number of properties accepted by the mechanical constitutive model assigned to zone z. See zone.mech.prop.name.

entries.name: zone.mech.ratio
entries.description: Get the current zone mechanical convergence ratio. See the zone ratio command.

entries.name: zone.mech.ratio.avg
entries.description: Get the current zone mechanical average convergence ratio. See the zone ratio command.

entries.name: zone.mech.ratio.local
entries.description: Get the current zone mechanical local convergence ratio. See the zone ratio command.

entries.name: zone.mech.ratio.max
entries.description: Get the current zone mechanical maximum convergence ratio. See the zone ratio command.

entries.name: zone.model
entries.description: Get/set the name of the current zone mechanical constitutive model. See the list of available models with the zone cmodel assign command.

entries.name: zone.model.init
entries.description: Initializes all constitutive models (mechanical, fluid, and thermal) assigned to the zone. This recalculates intermediate values based on the current properties. This may be necessary if property values are changed during cycling.

entries.name: zone.near
entries.description: Get the nearest zone to v. Will return null if there are no zones in the model. Excludes mechanically null zones.

entries.name: zone.near.all
entries.description: Get the nearest zone to v. Will return null if there are no zones in the model. Includes all null zones.

entries.name: zone.near.list
entries.description: Finds all zones with centroids within f distance of position v, and returns all of them in a list.

entries.name: zone.near.live
entries.description: Get the nearest zone to v.

entries.name: zone.near.map
entries.description: Finds all zones with centroids within f distance to position v, and returns all of them in a map.

entries.name: zone.next
entries.description: Get the next zone after z in the list of all zones in the model.

entries.name: zone.null
entries.description: Get/set the null state of the zone.

entries.name: zone.num
entries.description: Get the total number of zones in the model.

entries.name: zone.ortho
entries.description: Get a measure of orthogonality for the zone. A value near zero indicates that the zone is very non-orthogonal.

entries.name: zone.overlays
entries.description: Get the number of overlays available in the zone. This number is typically 1 for triangles and tetrahedrons and 2 for all other elements.

entries.name: zone.planarity
entries.description: Get a measure of how planar the quadrilateral faces of a zone are. A value of 0 means that all faces are perfectly planar. The greater this number, the more non-planar the faces are.

entries.name: zone.plane.traction
entries.description: Get the traction on the zone in the plane normal to vdir (3D or 2D vector).

entries.name: zone.pos
entries.description: Get the zone centroid position.

entries.name: zone.pp
entries.description: Get/set the average zone pore pressure. The assignment version is only valid if the zone-based pore pressures have been activated using the zone fluid zone-based-pp command.

entries.name: zone.prop
entries.description: Get/set the value of property s in the zone. The name s must match a property type available in the current constitutive model using keyword matching rules. If no property matches, an error occurs.

entries.name: zone.prop.index
entries.description: Returns the index associated with the property name s in the constitutive model used by zone z.

entries.name: zone.rotation.inc
entries.description: Get the zone rotational increment tensor, or a component of it. This is calculated using the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.rotation.inc.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone rotational increment tensor, or a component of it. This is calculated using the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.rotation.rate
entries.description: Get the zone rotation rate tensor or component. This is calculated using the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.rotation.rate.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone rotation rate tensor or component. This is calculated using the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.state
entries.description: Get/set the current plasticity state indicators for the zone.

entries.name: zone.state.restore
entries.description: Restores all zone state information from the currently open FISH file. See the file.open and file.read intrinsics.

entries.name: zone.state.save
entries.description: Saves all zone state information to the currently open FISH file. See the file.open and file.write intrinsics.

entries.name: zone.strain.inc
entries.description: Get the zone strain increment, based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.strain.inc.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone strain increment, based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.strain.rate
entries.description: Get the zone strain rate, based on the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.strain.rate.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone strain rate, based on the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.strain.shear.inc
entries.description: Get the zone shear strain increment based on the current displacement field. This is the square root of the second invariant of the strain increment deviator.

entries.name: zone.strain.shear.rate
entries.description: Get the zone shear strain rate based on the current velocity field. This is the square root of the second invariant of the strain rate deviator.

entries.name: zone.strain.vol.inc
entries.description: Get the zone volumetric strain increment based on the current displacement field. This is the trace of the strain increment tensor.

entries.name: zone.strain.vol.rate
entries.description: Get the zone volumetric strain rate based on the current velocity field. This is the trace of the strain rate tensor.

entries.name: zone.stress
entries.description: Get/set the zone stress.

entries.name: zone.stress.effective
entries.description: Get the zone effective stress. This is the volume-weighted average of the subzone (tetrahedrals in 3D, triangles in 2D) stresses, plus the zone-averaged pore pressure. Note that compressive stresses are negative.

entries.name: zone.stress.effective.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone effective stress. This is the volume-weighted average of the subzone stresses, plus the zone-averaged pore pressure.

entries.name: zone.stress.int
entries.description: Get the intermediate principal stress of the volume-weighted average of the subzone (triangle in 2D, tetrahedron in 3D) stresses.

entries.name: zone.stress.max
entries.description: Get the maximum (most positive) principal value of the volume-averaged subzone (triangle in 2D, tetrahedron in 3D) stress. Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC.

entries.name: zone.stress.min
entries.description: Get the minimum (most negative) principal value of the volume-averaged subzone (triangle in 2D, tetrahedron in 3D) stress. Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC.

entries.name: zone.stress.prin
entries.description: Get the zone principal stresses. Note that compressive stresses are negative.

entries.name: zone.stress.prin.dir
entries.description: Get the zone principal stress directions, calculated from the volume-averaged tetra stresses.

entries.name: zone.stress.prin.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the zone principal stress, calculated from the volume-weighted average of the tetra stresses. Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.stress.prin.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the zone principal stress, calculated from the volume-weighted average of the tetra stresses. Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.stress.prin.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the zone principal stress, calculated from the volume-weighted average of the tetra stresses. Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.stress.xx
entries.description: Get/set the xx-component of the zone stress.

entries.name: zone.temp
entries.description: Get/set the zone temperature. Normally this is the average temperature of the gridpoints. If the zone thermal zone-based-temperature command was used, then temperatures are stored and retrieved directly from the zone.

entries.name: zone.test.quality
entries.description: Get a measure of the zone quality, or how the zone shape may affect solution accuracy.

entries.name: zone.tet.gp
entries.description: Gets a list of the gridpoint pointers associated with one or more tetrahedra of a zone.

entries.name: zone.tet.num
entries.description: Get the number of tetra in each overlay of the zone.

entries.name: zone.tet.smallest.vol
entries.description: Get the volume of the smallest tetrahedron in an overlay.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc
entries.description: Get the zone tetra strain increments based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.xy
entries.description: Get the xy-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.xz
entries.description: Get the xz-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.yy
entries.description: Get the yy-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.yz
entries.description: Get the yz-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.inc.zz
entries.description: Get the zz-value of the zone tetra strain increment based on the current displacement field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.rate
entries.description: Get the zone tetra strain rate based on the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.tet.strain.rate.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the zone tetra strain rate based on the current velocity field.

entries.name: zone.tet.stress
entries.description: Get/set a list of the the zone tetra stresses.

entries.name: zone.tet.stress.xx
entries.description: Get/set the xx-component of a list of the the zone tetra stresses.

entries.name: zone.tet.vol
entries.description: Gets a list of the volumes associated with one or more tetrahedra of a zone.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.conductivity
entries.description: Get the thermal conductivity for the analytical thermal logic. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.diffusivity
entries.description: Get the thermal diffusivity for the analytical thermal logic. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.component.decay
entries.description: Get the source component decay constant for the input thermal analytical source and component number. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.component.fraction
entries.description: Get the source component fraction for the input thermal analytical source and component number. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.create
entries.description: Creates a new analytical thermal source at location v.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.extra
entries.description: Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the thermal analytical source. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to thermal analytical source src in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.id
entries.description: Get the analytical thermal source ID number, which is a unique number assigned by the code when it is created.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to a container of all analytical thermal sources in the model.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.near
entries.description: Get the thermal analytical source nearest v; will return null if there are no sources in the model.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.pos
entries.description: Get/set the source position for the input thermal analytical source. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the source location.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.strength
entries.description: Get/set the source strength for the input thermal analytical source. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.source.time
entries.description: Get/set the source start time for the input thermal analytical source. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.analytical.time
entries.description: Get the total solved time for the thermal analytical solution. This is only available if model configure thermal has been specified.

entries.name: zone.thermal.model
entries.description: Get/set the thermal flow constitutive model for the zone. The currently available constitutive models are advection-conduction, anisotropic, hydration, isotropic, and null.

entries.name: zone.thermal.prop
entries.description: Get/set the value for thermal property s in zone z.

entries.name: zone.thermal.prop.index
entries.description: Returns the index of thermal property s in the thermal material model used by zone z. This index can be used to retrieve a property value later more efficiently than by using a string property name. See the zone.thermal.prop function.

entries.name: zone.thermal.ratio
entries.description: Get the current thermal convergence ratio for zones. This is defined as the ratio of total unbalanced heat flow to the total heat flow through the zones.

entries.name: zone.thermal.time.total
entries.description: Get/set the total accumulated zone module thermal time. This accumulates the timesteps of every cycle the zone thermal module is active.

entries.name: zone.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For zones, this will always return ‭1283546101‬.

entries.name: zone.unbal
entries.description: Get the current maximum unbalanced force on any gridpoint in the model.

entries.name: zone.vol
entries.description: Get the zone volume (in 3D) or area (in 2D)calculated using the current position of the zone’s gridpoints.

entries.name: zone.vol.deformed
entries.description: Get the volume (in 3D) or area (in 2D) of a zone using gridpoint positions that take into account accumulated gridpoint displacements.

entries.name: zone.was.updated
entries.description: Returns TRUE if the last validation check actually performed a geometry update.

entries.name: zone.work.elastic.shear
entries.description: Get the shear elastic work. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.work.elastic.total
entries.description: Get the total elastic work. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.work.elastic.vol
entries.description: Get the volumetric elastic work. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.work.plastic.shear
entries.description: Get the shear plastic work dissipated. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.work.plastic.total
entries.description: Get the total plastic work dissipated. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.

entries.name: zone.work.plastic.vol
entries.description: Get the volumetric plastic work dissipated. See Energy Calculation in FLAC3D.
